initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
      - name: CURL_CA_BUNDLE
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      - name: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      - name: REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      - name: SSL_CERT_FILE
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
      - name: homelab-root-ca
        mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
        subPath: ca.crt
        readOnly: true
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - >-
            docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem
            --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:8b7a25c7b3235c27e97df1cbb8411c1d12d2676e739265b5fbb66bb55f72dbf6
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 8Gi
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
      - name: homelab-root-ca
        mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
        subPath: ca.crt
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: homelab-root-ca
    configMap:
      name: homelab-root-ca
      defaultMode: 420
restartPolicy: Never
serviceAccount: forgejo-runner
serviceAccountName: forgejo-runner

initContainers:
  - name: 01-nix-store
    image: nixos/nix:2.35.4@sha256:f159a58f390677f41e8e900a74b6e2f9c7f27b364122ae6acf7a652ce6c551c0
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ ! -d /data/store ]; then
          cp -a /nix/. /data/
        else
          # /etc in the image symlinks into /nix/store, so seed paths missing after image bumps
          cp -an /nix/store/. /data/store/
        fi
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        memory: 1Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: runner-nix-data
        mountPath: /data
containers:
  - image: nixos/nix:2.35.4@sha256:f159a58f390677f41e8e900a74b6e2f9c7f27b364122ae6acf7a652ce6c551c0
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    env:
      - name: NIX_CONFIG
        value: |-
          max-jobs = 2
          cores = 4
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 24Gi
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: runner-nix-data
        mountPath: /nix
volumes:
  - name: runner-nix-data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: runner-nix-data
restartPolicy: Never
serviceAccount: forgejo-runner
serviceAccountName: forgejo-runner
